caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a tea kettle, in the center of the image. The kettle is rendered in shades of brown and dark gray, with hints of yellowish highlights, giving it a metallic copper-like appearance. The body of the kettle is rounded and bulbous, with a defined circular lid on top. Extending from the left side is a long, curved spout, and from the upper sides of the body, two vertical supports rise to hold a large, angular handle which arches above the kettle. The background is a plain off-white or beige color, with a simple rectangular border enclosing the illustration. Handwritten text appears in the lower left corner, reading "Copper Tea Kettle," and in the lower right corner with what appears to be a name, date, and possibly a signature: "J. Goward (A.T.S.) 1936."
title: Copper Tea Kettle
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
